title: coelogyne tiongiana
intro: Coelogyne tiongiana, commonly known as the Borneo Coelogyne, is a species of orchid native to the island of Borneo. It is a type of epiphytic orchid that is known for its fragrant and showy flowers, which come in shades of white and yellow. The plant has been traditionally used in herbal medicine to treat various health conditions, and its health benefits include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of Coelogyne tiongiana include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which exhibit therapeutic actions such as wound healing, anti-cancer, and anti-diabetic activities.
